SUBJECT:  RESOLUTION NO. 24-63 – RESULTS OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL
  ELECTION HELD NOVEMBER 5, 2024

Background:

On June 4, 2024 City Council adopted Resolution No. 24-30 calling and giving notice of the
November 5, 2024 consolidated election with Los Angeles County to elect three members to the
City Council for full terms of four years. There were a total of five individuals who qualified to
run for the three four-year seats.

The County of Los Angeles has completed the canvass of the results and the appropriate
Resolution has been prepared for adoption. The results are attached as Exhibit “A” to Resolution
No. 24-63. The total number of ballots cast in this election were 36,230, equating to 62% of the
registered voters. Sixty-eight percent of the ballots cast were by Vote-By-Mail.

The election results declare that Rick Ramirez, Margarita L. Rios, and Ana Valencia were re-
elected to the Norwalk City Council for four-year terms.

   RESOLUTION NO. 24-63

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  RECITING THE FACT OF THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION HELD
  ON NOVEMBER 5, 2024, DECLARING THE RESULTS AND SUCH
  OTHER MATTERS AS PROVIDED BY LAW

  WHEREAS, a General Municipal Election was held and conducted in the City of
Norwalk, California, on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, consolidated with the State election
conducted by the Los Angeles County Registrar/Recorder as required by law; and

  WHEREAS, notice of the election was given in time, form, and manner as provided
by law; that voting precincts were properly established; that election officers were
appointed by the Registrar of Voters of Los Angeles County; and that in all respects the
election was held and conducted and the votes were cast, received and canvassed and
the returns made and declared in time, form and manner as required by the provisions of
the Elections Code of the State of California; and

  WHEREAS, pursuant to the Certificate of Election dated December 3, 2024,
provided by the Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk, the Registrar of
Voters of Los Angeles County canvassed the returns of the November 5, 2024 election
and has certified the results to this City Council, the results are received, attached and
made a part hereof as “Exhibit A.”

  NOW, THEREFORE, THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK DOES
HEREBY RESOLVE AS FOLLOWS:

  Section 1. The whole number of ballots cast in the precincts except vote by mail
ballots was 11,619; the whole number of vote by mail ballots cast was 24,611 for a total
of 36,230 ballots cast; 58,277 registered voters; 62% voter turnout.

  Section 2. The names of persons voted for and elected at the election for
Member of the Norwalk City Council are as follows in alphabetical order:

  Rick Ramirez
  Margarita L. Rios
  Ana Valencia

  Section 3. The number of votes given at each precinct and the number of votes
given in the City to each of the persons above named for the office of Member of the City
Council are as listed in Exhibit A.

  Section 4. The City Council does declare and determine that Rick Ramirez,
Margarita L. Rios, and Ana Valencia were each elected as Members of the City Council
of said City for the term of four years.
   Section 5. As reported and certified by the Los Angeles County Registrar-
Recorder/County Clerk, Exhibit A shows: (1) The whole number of votes cast in the City;
(2) The names of the persons voted for; (3) For what office each person was voted for;
(4) The number of votes given at each precinct to each person; and (5) The total number
of votes given to each person.

  Section 6. The City Clerk shall make and deliver to each of the persons so
elected a Certificate of Election signed by the City Clerk and authenticated; that the City
Clerk shall also administer to each person elected the Oath of Office prescribed in the
Constitution of the State of California and shall have them subscribe to it and file it in the
office of the City Clerk. Each and all of the persons so elected shall then be inducted into
the respective office to which they have been elected.

  Section 7. The Mayor, or presiding officer, is hereby authorized to affix her
signature to this Resolution signifying its adoption by the City Council of the City of
Norwalk and the City Clerk, or her duly appointed assistant, is directed to attest thereto.

  APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 10th day of December 2024.

  ___________________________
  MARGARITA L. RIOS
  MAYOR

SUBJECT:  CITY COUNCIL REORGANIZATION

Background:

Annually, City Council selects one of its members to serve as Mayor and one to serve as Vice
Mayor. Following is the procedure for reorganization:

1. The City Clerk will declare that the next item of business shall be the selection of a Mayor
  and a Vice Mayor for the upcoming year.

2. The City Clerk declares that nominations are in order for the office of Mayor. The City Clerk
  accepts nominations; a second to the nomination is not necessary. If there are no further
  nominations, the City Clerk will close the nominations and take a roll call vote. If more than
  one nomination, a vote will be taken in the order of the nomination. Following the vote(s),
  the City Clerk declares the Mayor elected.

3. The newly elected Mayor will preside over the election of the Vice Mayor in the same manner
  as outlined for the Mayor and conduct the remainder of the meeting.

SUBJECT:  PLANNING COMMISSIONER APPOINTMENTS

Background:

Section 2.16.020 of the Norwalk Municipal Code provides that the terms of the members of the
Norwalk Planning Commission shall be coexistent with that of the City Councilmember making
the appointment. As Councilmembers Ramirez, Rios, and Valencia were re-elected, they may
either re-appoint their current commissioners or choose new representatives.

The Office of the City Clerk has posted the mandatory vacancy notice in order to allow
appointments to be made at this meeting. The next meeting of the Planning Commission is
scheduled for December 11. New appointments are needed to allow the Commission to
continue to function.

SUBJECT:  RESOLUTION NO. 24-66 - ALTERNATE APPOINTMENTS TO THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY CITY SELECTION COMMITTEE

Background:

The City is a participating member of the Los Angeles County City Selection Committee which
meets monthly. The Mayor is the automatic Delegate unless the City designates another
Councilmember as the City’s voting member.

In January, City Council adopted Resolution No. 24-03 appointing Vice Mayor Ayala as the
Delegate and Mayor Rios as the Alternate. However, in the event neither of these two are able
to attend an upcoming meeting December 17, the attached resolution has been prepared
expanding the list of Alternates to include all other Councilmembers as Alternates to ensure that
the City is fully represented at the December 2024 meeting.

  DESIGNATING JENNIFER PEREZ, RICK RAMIREZ, AND ANA
  VALENCIA AS ADDITIONAL ALTERNATES FOR THE LOS ANGELES
  COUNTY CITY SELECTION COMMITTEE/EASTERN REGION

  WHEREAS, the Los Angeles County City Selection Committee/Eastern Region is
charged with the responsibility of voting on certain County-related matters and
Boardmembers;

  WHEREAS, in January 2024, City Council appointed Vice Mayor Ayala and Mayor
Rios as Delegate and Alternate, respectively; and

  WHEREAS, City Council desires to appoint Jennifer Perez, Rick Ramirez, and Ana
Valencia as additional Alternates for the purposes of voting on behalf of the City if the
current Delegate and Alternate are not available to attend a meeting.

  NOW, THEREFORE THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
HEREBY DETERMINES, FINDS, AND RESOLVES AS FOLLOWS:

  Section 1. Should Vice Mayor Ayala or Councilmember Rios be unable to
attend said meeting, then Councilmembers Jennifer Perez, Rick Ramirez, or Ana
Valencia are designated as additional official representatives of the City in their place and
stead.

  Section 2. The Mayor, or presiding officer, is hereby authorized to affix their
signature to this Resolution signifying its adoption by the City Council of the City of
Norwalk and the City Clerk, or her duly appointed assistant, is directed to attest thereto.

  APPROVED AND ADOPTED on this 10th day of December 2024.
